name: New Era
verdict: Owned by New Era Cap, LLC, a family-owned (Koch) company with a significant ACON Investments stake. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf and all 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners); appears on every team page. Rating note: family-owned by the Koch family (fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch), first institutional investor ACON Investments holds a significant stake; MLB, the NFL and the NBA became minority owners through ACON's August 2022 continuation fund (ACON's own release; Apollo, GCM Grosvenor, Hamilton Lane and Neuberger Berman backed the fund on behalf of managed funds). No state or state-fund owner identified.
